picks.name: Untold
picks.source_note: Already in your library. New label discovery -- Hemlock Recordings, his own imprint. Part of a run of 2026 releases following his return to activity.
picks.bio: "Crop Milk" (October 30, 2026, Hemlock Recordings, cat. HEK038) is a new EP from UK producer Untold (Jack Dunning), part of a string of 2026 releases on his own Hemlock label following his quiet resurfacing last year.
picks.why_listen: Sparse, bass-heavy club tracks from a long-running UK underground figure -- good for a leftfield, rhythmically unusual stretch of a set.

picks.name: Alsarah & The Nubatones
picks.source_note: New artist/label discovery -- Wonderwheel Recordings. El Búho (already in your library) provides the closing remix on this EP.
picks.bio: "Seasons of the Road Remix EP" (November 6, 2026, Wonderwheel Recordings) closes out remixes of the Brooklyn-based, Sudanese-led band's 2025 album, with this final remix -- El Búho reimagining the Sufi love song "Sudani" as "Sudani (El Búho Remix)."
picks.why_listen: Nubian-rooted East African retro-pop reworked with a gentle, cumbia-adjacent touch -- a good warm, melodic change of pace in a set.

release.title: Seasons of the Road Remix EP
